examples: I wasn't tall when I was five.
They were at the park on Sunday.
You weren't shy when you were six.

grammar_patterns.pattern: He had [adjective] [noun] when he was young.
examples: He had black hair when he was young.
Grandma had long, black, straight hair.

grammar_patterns.pattern: You didn't have a [noun] when you were a baby.
examples: You didn't have a book when you were a baby.
He had a book then, too!
He had a nice apartment, and a happy family.

phonics.description: The long i sound spelled igh, y, and i_e.

key_sentences: This is Dad when he was young. He was handsome then!
Grandma was pretty! I think Grandma is still pretty!
He had black hair when he was young.
This is a photo of you when you were a baby.
Look! I had a bag then, too!
When my grandpa was a boy, he had lots of friends.
When my grandma was a girl, her eyes were bright and blue.
He had blond hair when he was a boy.
